notes:
Patch 0.1.15 (auto-patch)

Players on 0.1.14 can take this in-game: the menu checks the patch list, downloads the zip parts, then applies after a short countdown you can cancel. Mega is still for first-time installs and anyone below 0.1.14.

Combat and play
- Death camera stays near your body instead of jumping to a far orbit.
- Wild rune sprites dissolve and despawn when beaten to 0 HP (they no longer sit immortal after Health hits zero).
- Rune sprite idle/walk animates on host and clients.
- Other players' locomotion animates through instead of freezing on the first frame.
- Host after Create Server unlocks move/look and mouse lock correctly.
- Nightling mortar charges before release; longer charge means bigger blast, damage, and push.
- Nightling body hits register on more of the mesh.
- Ride-bug stand height matches host on clients (lift raised).
- Creature splash / relationship hits reach rune sprites and other factions more reliably.
- Loot chests roll the full weapon and armor sets (rare/epic stay high-end).

World and sky
- Partly cloudy days sit between clear blue and storm decks (broken cumulus mid-cover).
- Clear stays sparse fair-weather puffs; storms stay dark and packed.
- Tree shade no longer steals sun light off nearby trees as you move.
- Players stay visible out to the fog distance.
- Pause menu: Resume at the top with spacing; Quit Game at the bottom with spacing.
- Pause keeps look/walk off and the mouse unlocked.
- Mushroom fairy VFX no longer hard square particles.

Website
- Visitor total / today and download counters on the site footer.

Still from 0.1.14
- Shared creature relationship table (Attack / Flee / Ally / Ignore).
- Auto-download via direct https zip parts on the public patch list.
